zh-CN.title: 启动器首页接入官网公告
zh-CN.body: 新版启动器会同步官网的更新公告。展开首页的「更新公告」即可阅读，离线时可查看上次同步的内容。官网已预留 APK 下载入口，当前暂未开放。

zh-CN.title: 恢复游戏内语言切换
zh-CN.body: 修复游戏内语言切换，并为 Terraria PE 资源转换增加配置校验。

zh-CN.title: 启动器支持简体中文和英文
zh-CN.body: 新增启动器界面的简体中文和英文选项。同日加入 Terraria PE 资源转换支持，可从设备上已安装的游戏导入兼容资源。

en.title: Website updates on the launcher home screen
en.body: The updated launcher shows the same announcements as the website. Expand Updates on the home screen to read them, including previously synced updates while offline. The website has a download section; the APK is not available yet.

en.title: In-game language switching restored
en.body: This update fixes in-game language switching and checks the conversion profile before converting Terraria PE resources.

en.title: The launcher now supports English and Simplified Chinese
en.body: You can now switch the launcher interface between English and Simplified Chinese. Support for importing compatible resources from an installed copy of Terraria PE also landed that day.
